packageRules.description: Group all Node.js updates; wait 3d so packages clear pnpm's minimumReleaseAge (24h) cutoff and CI/automerge can go green without a manual rebase
CI's Mongo service stays at 8.2: 8.3 and 9 refuse to start on the Linux 6.19+ runners (#356)
The API type generator keeps a TypeScript below 7 of its own: openapi-typescript drives the compiler API that typescript@7 no longer exposes (ui/pnpm-workspace.yaml)
An override lifts a vulnerable range to its patched floor within the major its consumers asked for; widening its upper bound would hand them a major they never asked for
